subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should this release accept the one-way device-identity storage cutover, including Doctor-required legacy import and coordinated upgrades for processes sharing a state directory?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the recovery and downgrade contract for cryptographic device identity; source review can assess the implementation, but release timing and acceptable operator impact require maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the database-first cutover
options.body: Merge with the documented Doctor migration and explicit release guidance that old JSON-only binaries must not share the migrated state directory.

options.title: Defer to a coordinated release
options.body: Hold this PR until native and Node distribution timing can guarantee aligned upgrades and the downgrade support message is approved.

recommendation.title: Accept the database-first cutover
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented Doctor migration and explicit release guidance that old JSON-only binaries must not share the migrated state directory.
